io.milvus.bulkwriter.response

Class GetImportProgressResponse

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.response.GetImportProgressResponse
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class GetImportProgressResponse
extends Object
implements Serializable
    A response containing the progress of a bulk import job.

    It describes the import job through its job ID, target collection, imported file, state, progress percentage, completion time, reason for failure, total imported rows, and per-file GetImportProgressResponse.Detail entries.

    See Also:
